newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Lithia begun with buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Lithia begun with buy.

text.p: -- Dain Bosworth Inc said Monday it initiated coverage of Lithia Motors Inc, the largest retailer of new and used automobiles in southwest Oregon, with a buy rating.

-- In a research report, analyst Mark Bartholomay noted Lithia has an executive management team with vast industry experience, focused acquisition skills, an operating model already providing results, and attractive valuation.
-- The company went public in December.
-- A 12-18 month price target of $20 is reasonable, Bartholomay said. Shares were up 1/4 at 11-1/2 Monday.
